source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

packed_tags.topic: Mixtures, solutions, pure substances and separation

intelligence.enrichment: An element is a pure substance made of identical particles; in many elements, two or more such particles combine to form a stable molecule of that same element. Having only one kind of particle makes a pure substance an element, even if those particles are grouped into molecules. The learner correctly applies this rule: An element is a pure substance made of identical particles; in many elements, two or more such particles combine to form a stable molecule of that same element. If atoms combine into a molecule, the substance must be a compound.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Elements, compounds and mixtures. The student must decide: Classify a substance as an element when it is a pure substance made of only one kind of identical particle. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names.
